title: Before You Sign an AI Contract, Run This Exit Test

segments.headline: YOUR AI VENDOR HAS YOUR DATA
segments.spoken: Your AI vendor has your workflows and business data. Before you sign, ask one question: could your company leave tomorrow?

segments.headline: EXPORT A REAL SAMPLE
segments.body: Download records, prompts and logs in usable formats.
segments.spoken: First, export a small real sample. Check whether records, prompts and logs arrive in formats another system can read.

segments.headline: REBUILD THE WORKFLOW
segments.body: Test prompts, integrations and permissions outside the vendor.
segments.spoken: Second, try rebuilding one workflow elsewhere. A data export alone does not restore your integrations, prompts, or permissions.

segments.headline: VERIFY THE EXIT TERMS
segments.body: Deletion, backup retention, fees and transition support.
segments.spoken: Third, confirm deletion, backup retention, exit fees and transition support in writing. Ask who verifies the result.

segments.headline: PASS, PILOT OR PAUSE
segments.body: No verified exit path? Limit production dependence.
segments.spoken: If the exit test fails, limit dependence until the supplier fixes the gap. This is a proposed management test, not a universal legal requirement.

segments.headline: KEEP THE RIGHT TO LEAVE
segments.body: PrismBay AI | Practical AI business systems
segments.spoken: PrismBay AI helps founders and executives implement practical AI systems. Subscribe for measurable business decisions, not vendor promises.

hypothesis: A concrete vendor exit test earns stronger 72-hour retention and qualified engagement than general AI procurement warnings
